paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation: This chart presents a comparison between the performance of smaller large language models (LLMs) using compute-optimal test-time scaling (TTS) and larger LLMs using chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting across two benchmarks: MATH-500 (left three subplots, labeled a–c) and AIME24 (right three subplots, labeled d–f). The legend at the top distinguishes bar types by two visual encodings: fill pattern (solid borders for CoT, hatched for TTS) and color corresponding to specific models—Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (blue with diagonal hatching), Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct (green), o1-mini (pink), DeepSeek-R1 (light blue with a logo), o1 (gray), TTS (hatched), GPT-4o (purple), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B (pink with diagonal hatching), o1-preview (beige/tan), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B (peach with diagonal hatching). Each subplot has a horizontal axis showing model parameter sizes (e.g., 3B, 405B, unk, 1.5B, 7B, 671B) and a vertical axis representing performance scores. In subplots (a)–(c) for MATH-500, the vertical axis ranges from approximately 65 to 100 with tick intervals of 5. In subplot (a), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct with TTS (blue hatched, 3B) reaches 78.2, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct with CoT (solid, labeled "unk" on the axis but annotated as 405B contextually) reaches 74.6, and GPT-4o (green, 405B) reaches 71.4. In subplot (b), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B with TTS (pink hatched, 1.5B) reaches 91.6, o1-mini (pink solid, "unk") reaches 90.0, and o1-preview (tan solid, "unk") reaches 85.5. In subplot (c), DeepSeek-R1 (light blue solid with logo, 671B) reaches 97.3, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B with TTS (peach hatched, 7B) reaches 95.2, and o1 (gray solid, "unk") reaches 94.8. For AIME24 in subplots (d)–(f), the vertical axis ranges from 0 to 90 with tick intervals of 10. In subplot (d), Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct with TTS (blue hatched, 3B) reaches 30.0, Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct with CoT (green, 405B) reaches 23.3, and GPT-4o (purple, "unk") reaches 9.3. In subplot (e), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B with TTS (pink hatched, "unk") reaches 63.6, o1-mini (pink solid, 1.5B) reaches 63.3, and o1-preview (tan solid, "unk") reaches 44.6. In subplot (f), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B with TTS (peach hatched, 7B) reaches 83.3, DeepSeek-R1 (light blue solid with logo, 671B) reaches 79.8, and o1 (gray solid, "unk") reaches 79.2. Within each subplot, the bars are arranged in descending order of value from left to right. TTS bars are visually distinguished from CoT bars through diagonal hatching patterns, while CoT bars use solid fills, and several bars feature small model logos embedded within them (such as the Meta, OpenAI, and DeepSeek logos).
